$SSL_bDisableScaleHighlight	!!! Only Enable if Needed !!!\nDisables all internal uses of SetScale() within SexLab, which is known to cause crashes during animation start for some users. Some scaling may still occur through other means, such as furniture use, which SexLab will be unable to correct for while this is enabled. Your results may vary.
